- Between panels: green square with black center
- Right panel: frame at top-right
The green squares seem to be on a horizontal track between the panels. When I press RIGHT, they both move right. When I press LEFT, they both move left.
Maybe the goal is to position the green squares so they match the frames? Or maybe I need to use MOUSE to interact with specific objects?

        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        center = (sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols))
        print(f"  Green: center={center}, children={n['children']}")
    if n['color'] == 'c' and n['pixels'] < 20:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        center = (sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols))
        print(f"  Frame: center={center}, hash={n['hash'][:12]}, pixels={n['pixels']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
